coherence_resolved_c10_witness.interpretation: The serialized population transition admits coherence-resolved CPTP realizations with distinct coherent-state responses. The common quantum contraction therefore carries the coherence map together with the population kernel.

common_spectral_map.matrix_moments: C_n^(6)=V^dagger U^n V on the fixed source order (L1,L2,L3,R1,R2,R3)
common_spectral_map.neutrinos: m_nu_i=(hbar/(c^2 tau_*))*sigma_i with sigma_i the active Takagi coordinates of the interacting neutral Nambu kernel
common_spectral_map.quarks: short-distance masses are read from the color-resolved renormalized chirality-changing inverse propagator in the declared scheme and scale
common_spectral_map.spectral_measure: G_2 is the positive 6x6 matrix-valued spectral measure associated with the common frozen action and selected source subspace

operator_completion_principle: The common spectral observable is evaluated after the coherence-resolved C10 map, boundary-to-path insertion, six-column embedding, charged causal-cone action and selected Riesz state are represented on one frozen finite-volume action.
